title: Visawe (Theme 8: Wanyama wa majini)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 6 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child finds more than three words of the same meaning by testing each in the same sentence, and uses one in place of another.
steps: Keep those that keep the meaning.
Use one in a new sentence.

board.say: Ni maneno gani yana maana sawa?

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child writes fedha, hela, darahimu and uses one in a sentence about selling fish.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Kisawe cha "furaha" ni ___." Kwa nini "huzuni" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Visawe ni maneno yenye maana sawa. Furaha na huzuni ni vinyume, si visawe.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Kisawe cha "huzuni" ni ___." Kwa nini "kilio" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Neno linalohusiana na jingine si lazima liwe na maana sawa nalo. Kisawe cha huzuni ni simanzi.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Kisawe cha "haraka" ni ___." Kwa nini "harufu" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Maneno yanaweza kuanza kwa herufi zilezile na yasiwe na maana sawa. Kisawe cha haraka ni upesi.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Ni kundi lipi lina maneno yote yenye maana sawa na "furaha"?" Kwa nini "bashasha, huzuni, raha, tabasamu" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Kila neno la kundi lazima liwe na maana sawa. Huzuni ni kinyume cha furaha.
